$comment: Routes fold:check measures (visual-direction § 1.3, scripts/fold-check.mjs): every top-level band <= maxBand (830 at 1470 x 830, 1700 at 390), and, where a viewport states its nav, every [data-fold-hero] + nav <= its height (the hero ends above the fold at 1470; at 390 only the band rule applies). A measurement inside data-fold-exempt is reported with its reason, never failed. The Case Studies listing is measured with its index list exempt.
